title: Catalog admin
aboutText: Guest data lives in this server process only and resets when the server restarts. Drafts are stored on this device, scoped to your session, and cleared when you log out.

activity.heading: Recent activity
activity.offline: Offline copy. Read-only until the connection returns.

drafts.restored: Draft restored from this device. Review it, then save.
drafts.interrupted: Not sent. Your draft is saved on this device. Save again when you are back online.
drafts.reconnected: Connection restored. Reload the page to review your saved draft, then save again.

offlineHint: Connection may be unavailable. Changes are not sent until you try again.
noscript: Interactive panels need JavaScript. Every product action also has a plain page.
